name: Reputation
oneLiner: Enterprise reputation and customer experience platform (formerly Reputation.com) that combines reviews, listings, surveys, social and AI search visibility for multi-location brands.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant, hospitality, automotive and healthcare brands that need reviews, surveys and listings managed centrally with enterprise reporting.

updates.text: Expanded the platform with deeper customer insights features.
Unveiled new AI-powered products and features for brand intelligence.
Launched Reputation IQ (plain-English questions across your data), an expanded AI Reputation Manager (how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity present your brand) and AI Location Presence Insights.

features: Review monitoring and response across Google, Yelp, Facebook, Tripadvisor and other sites from one inbox
Review requests by SMS, email and QR code, triggered by dine-in, delivery or POS events
Surveys and customer feedback alongside public reviews
Sentiment and text analytics that group feedback into themes such as service or cleanliness
AI search visibility tools: AI Reputation Manager and AI Location Presence Insights
Reputation IQ for asking questions of your feedback data in plain English

pricing.text: Published plans, per location per month: Rep Core $80 (review management with AI responding, listings and SEO), Rep Core + Pulse $115 (adds Rep Score, AI Reputation Manager, Pulse analytics, one basic survey template), Rep Core + Surveys $150 (six advanced survey templates, email survey requests, outreach campaigns). Enterprise is custom for 125+ locations. Add-ons (Competitive Insights, Actions & Ticketing, Social Suite, Premium Sources, Premium Integrations, managed services) are priced on request. No free trial; demo on request.

notes: Rebranded from Reputation.com to Reputation; still uses the reputation.com domain, HQ San Ramon, CA; marked its 20th year in March 2026. No acquisition of the company found. reputation.com/pricing now publishes per-location plans ($80, $115, $150 per location per month; Enterprise custom for 125+ locations), checked November 2026; the page doesn't say whether billing is annual or monthly. Mitchells & Butlers case study dates from 2018. Dropped from the current review: the claim that its portfolio is 'primarily healthcare' (it also targets hospitality, automotive and others; not re-checked). Also copied to reputation-com.json. G2 rating from search snippets of g2.com/products/reputation/reviews (4.5 from 2,470; other G2 pages show 4.6 or 2,520 reviews). reputation-com.json (another tool's sheet) still says custom pricing and wasn't edited here.
pros: Wide scope: reviews, listings, surveys, social and AI search visibility in one platform
Published per-location prices, from $80 per location per month
Review requests by SMS, email or QR code, triggered by dine-in, delivery or POS events
AI search tools (AI Reputation Manager, AI Location Presence Insights) show how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity present a brand
Reputation IQ answers plain-English questions about feedback data

cons.text: Per-location pricing adds up for large groups: $80 to $150 per location per month on the published plans
Surveys depend on the plan: Rep Core has none, Rep Core + Pulse has one basic template, and full surveys need Rep Core + Surveys at $150
Social suite, actions and ticketing, competitive insights and premium integrations are add-ons with no published price
No free trial on the pricing page; you request a demo
Enterprise plan (custom pricing) is for 125+ locations
Serves many industries (healthcare, automotive, real estate, financial services, retail as well as food and beverage), so it is less restaurant-specific than tools built only for restaurants
